# VERATIS

> Research-grade peptides with third-party verified purity, public certificates of analysis, and cold-chain dispatch.

VERATIS manufactures lyophilized research peptides under cGMP and releases every lot only after independent HPLC and mass-spectrometry verification by an ISO 17025 accredited laboratory. Each vial carries a unique lot identifier traceable to a public certificate of analysis.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the VERATIS verification system and featured compounds.
- [Catalog](/shop): Full catalog of research peptides, stacks, and reconstitution supplies.
- [COA Archive](/coa-archive): Searchable archive of every certificate of analysis ever issued.
- [Verify Batch](/verify): Authenticate a vial by entering its lot number.
- [Testing Standards](/standards): Analytical methods, release specifications, and storage protocols.
- [Education](/blog): Reference articles on peptide handling, storage, and laboratory protocol.
- [About](/about): Company background and laboratory partners.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers about purity testing, shipping, storage, and intended use.
- [Shipping & Returns](/shipping-returns): Rates, transit times, cold-chain packaging, and returns.
- [How To Pay](/how-to-pay): Bitcoin payment workflow.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the VERATIS team.
